headline: Property management, monitoring reports, farmland lease bid status, and an executive session on real estate.
summary: The commission will review a transition project report, property management updates including trees of heaven treatment, and monitoring reports for several properties. It will also discuss farmland lease bid status and hold an executive session on real estate matters.
